title: Tai Tam Byewash Reservoir Dam

terrainReference.basis: Downstream center of the original Lands Department section in Hong Kong Principal Datum.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap mapped Byewash Dam and associated reservoir
mapIdentity.scope: Original mapped dam way 270274610 and the impounded edge of Byewash Reservoir way 22505710. The official 50 m observed length informs the wing extent.

note: Continuous masonry-faced overflow sill and rounded crest, fitted to the unmodified native elevation preview near the documented full water level. The profile includes battered walls, coursed-rubble wings and the west gauge stair.
